_comment: Search titles and descriptions per page, applied by scripts/docsify-to-starlight.py (also with --metadata-only). Keys are paths under src/content/docs. 'title' replaces the page heading, 'searchTitle' (optional) is the browser-tab and search-result title when it should say more than the heading, 'edition' (both, self-hosted or cloud), 'plugin' ({name, url}) and 'checked' (the Leantime version last checked, e.g. "3.14") set the label row under the title (defaults per folder in src/lib/availability.ts), 'description' is the meta description (aim for 110-158 characters), 'draft: true' leaves an empty page out of the build, 'glance' is the At a glance box of a task page (minutes, maxMinutes, level, needs, where, result; see CONTRIBUTING.md) and replaces the page's '**At a glance**' Markdown block. New pages and override pages set these in their own front matter instead.
